evidence.source_sentence: Gel permeation chromatography (GPC) was performed on a Waters 150-C instrument using Styragel columns and a differential refractometer detector. The molecular weight calibration was carried out using polystyrene standards. Calibration and measurements were made at a flow rate of 1 ml/min, and dimethylformamide (DMF) was used as a solvent.

The molecular weights and dispersity of the polymers were investigated using the GPC method with DMF as a solvent calibrated with polystyrene standards. The results are compiled in Table 2. The numerous molecular weights $\left( M _ { \mathrm { n } } \right)$ ranged from 14,200 to 22,000 corresponding to a degree of polymerization between 25 and 42. The $M _ { \mathrm { w } }$ values were about 35,700–48,500 which means that the ratio of $M _ { \mathrm { w } } / M _ { \mathrm { n } }$ was between 2.20 and 2.51.
